name: Minowa Castle
description: Minowa Castle was a 16th-century mountain castle of the Takeda-aligned Nagano clan in western Kanto. The extensive yamajiro (mountain castle) earthworks with moats and kuruwa are preserved as a national historic site.
notes: Free open-air site; best with sturdy shoes. Interpretation at the site boards (Japanese).
